name: How do I choose the right soft close drawer slides for my cabinets?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right soft close drawer slides for my cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right soft close drawer slides involves considering several factors. First, measure your existing drawer box depth and cabinet opening to ensure compatibility. Determine the required weight capacity based on what you store in the drawers. Decide between undermount for a hidden look or side-mount for budget and ease of installation. Also, consider the extension type (full or partial). A professional can help assess your specific needs and cabinet structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose slides based on drawer depth, cabinet opening, weight capacity, desired aesthetic (undermount/side-mount), and extension type.
